THE TRADE IN PUNE

How jewellery is bought, made and sold in Pune.

Pune’s jewellery trade is centred on Laxmi Road and Raviwar Peth, with long-established family jewellers known for traditional Maharashtrian designs and a growing number of branch networks across the city and its suburbs.

Family firms here are opening second and third branches. That is the point where one person’s memory stops being enough: stock is in three places, staff change, and the owner wants the day’s numbers without calling each shop.

USE CASES

Where Jwero pays off for jewellers in Pune.

Everyday situations in the trade here, and what changes.

01

Gold moves in the morning and every tag in the showroom is wrong.

Set today's rate once and Jwero reprices every piece by weight, purity, making charge and stones, so the counter and the bill use the same figure.

What changesNobody recalculates tags by hand after a rate change.

02

A customer wants a set that is sitting at your other branch.

Search stock across every branch, then raise a stock transfer that tracks the piece out of one branch and into the other.

What changesYou sell the piece instead of saying it is not here.

03

A bride's family wants a full set quoted before they decide.

Build a quote with each piece, its metal, stones and making, share it as a link, and hold the price for the period you set.

What changesThe family discusses a clear quote at home.

04

A customer pays with old gold, some cash and UPI.

The billing screen tests and values her old gold, takes it against the new piece, and splits the rest across cash and UPI on one GST bill.

What changesOne bill instead of a slip, a register entry and a calculator.

QUESTIONS

What jewellers in Pune ask.

What is the best jewellery software for jewellers in Pune?

For Pune’s trade, which here means single store, growing to more branches and bridal, Jwero runs the counter, stock, customers, karigar accounts and books on one record, priced from the live rate. It is set up in a day over chat and video, with no office visit needed. Run it yourself for ₹18,000 a month, first month ₹3,600, or let Jwero’s team run it.

We are opening a second shop. What changes?

Nothing has to be rebuilt. The second location is added to the same record, so stock, customers, prices and books are shared from the first day.

Can my staff learn this without a computer person in the shop?

Billing, tags and customer lookups are on simple screens built for the counter. You can import your existing stock from Excel, and we help you set up rates, making charges and label formats before you go live.

Do all branches share one customer list?

Yes. A customer who buys at one branch is known at every branch, with her purchases, schemes and occasions on one record, so any salesman can serve her.

Is there a Jwero office in Pune?

No. Jwero is set up and supported over chat, call and video call, so a jeweller in Pune gets the same team as one anywhere else in India. Your data is imported for you and training is done on your own screen.

What does jewellery software cost for a shop in Pune?

The price is the same in every city: ₹18,000 a month, with every module included. The first month is ₹3,600. WhatsApp messages, AI and calls run on a prepaid wallet at published rates.

Do I have to give up Tally?

No. Sales, purchases and payments are kept in Jwero with GST handled. Jwero connects to Tally and Zoho Books, imports masters and checks records against them; entries are still posted in Tally by your accountant.
